items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And then he joined Clyde Coors band. And I come in there after Morgan.

ctx.x: Clyde Carr came up in the, here this year. I worked with Clyde Carr. I worked with Clyde Carr for about 5 years. Clyde Carr the Rap Solians, you heard of them? I heard of the Rap Solians, yeah. Mmhmm. Sidney Kitts had a big band. Mmhmm. They had the Moonlight Serenators. Mmhmm. They had more than that, I'm trying to think of them. Yes. And big bands were popular in those days. Hell yeah.
What about the bands coming in from out of town?
